Emerald Gardens Resort — Wedding & Destination Venue, Bengaluru Outskirts

Emerald Gardens is a resort-style wedding venue on the outskirts of Bengaluru,
set across landscaped gardens with multiple ceremony spaces, an indoor banquet
hall, and on-site accommodation for up to 120 guests. It markets itself as a
convenient near-city destination-wedding option.

The lawn-plus-banquet package is ₹6,00,000 per day, with accommodation and
catering bundled in tiered plans. The venue has in-house catering and a
preferred-decorator list, with outside vendors permitted on select packages.

Contact: +91 96860 90234 · weddings@emeraldgardens.example
Location: Nelamangala, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka
Rating: 4.5 / 5 (142 reviews)

What couples say:
"Beautiful gardens and the on-site rooms made it easy for outstation guests."
"Loved having multiple ceremony spots in one property."
"Convenient near-city location for a destination feel."

Emerald Gardens offers an all-inclusive wedding coordinator and handles
ceremony-to-reception transitions across its different lawns, which works well
for multi-event weddings spread over two or three days.

Prospective couples should be aware of issues raised in several 2023 reviews:
multiple parties reported that the on-site accommodation was double-booked on
peak dates, leaving some guests without the rooms they had paid for, and one
couple stated that the promised second lawn was reassigned to another event at
the last minute, forcing their mehendi into a smaller indoor space. There were
also two complaints that the security deposit was refunded only after repeated
follow-ups over several weeks. Management attributes these to an overbooking
issue during a system migration that it says has since been resolved.

Overall, Emerald Gardens is an attractive near-city destination option,
provided room allocations and lawn assignments are confirmed in writing well
ahead of the event.
